content: Replace the established v0.2.0 assignment for Intel x86_64 support and physical NVIDIA binding-performance qualification with an explicit v1.0.0 / M1000 boundary, preserve native NixOS qualification under v0.2.0, synchronize affected current and historical records through D0027/SC0003, and hand the replacement to every affected active session without manufacturing hardware evidence.

Applied SC0003 at migration content revision d9c67e47eff7ae17a4b6404412c946c81544afe2: synchronized all inventoried current, tooling, and historical surfaces; preserved locked evidence; and observed both target owners adopt and remove transient guidance G003 and G005.
